<a id="logs"></a>
## Logs { #logs }

**Security > Network Firewall > Console User Guide > Log**

In the **Log** tab, you can search for logs created by the Network Firewall.

<br>

<a id="search-logs"></a>
## Search Logs { #search-logs }

<a id="traffic"></a>
### Traffic { #traffic }

* Searches traffic logs generated by allow or block policies when traffic passes through Network Firewall.
    * You can search only historical data up to 3 months in 1-month increments.
        * The maximum number of stored logs is 8 million, and the amount of logs stored depends on the amount of traffic, so past data may not be retrieved.
    * If separate data storage is required, see the **log remote transmission settings** in the **Options** tab.

<a id="audit"></a>
### Audit { #audit }

* Searches logs for changes to the Network Firewall, including policy creation and deletion.
    * You can search for up to one month, and can search through CloudTrail, an organizational service.

<br>

<a id="download-excel"></a>
## Download Excel { #download-excel }

* Click **Download Excel** to download traffic and audit log search results.
    * The maximum number of downloads in a traffic log is 300,000.
